name: airplane-mode
title: Airplane Mode
description: Controls Android airplane mode from the chat. Rooted phones: fully automatic verified toggle. Non-rooted phones: guided MANUAL mode — the module verifies the REAL state with the world-readable probe (works offline) and walks you through the toggle. Type /airplane on, /airplane off or /airplane status while this module is active; commands run app-side, so they keep working even while airplane mode is ON and the AI chat is unreachable. Root toggles additionally need the 'Device commands (root)' switch in Settings → Modules.
